title: Password spraying pattern
why_it_fired: Source 127.0.0.1 failed authentication for 9 distinct users in 10 minutes; threshold is 8.
rule_threshold: 8 distinct users / 10 minutes / same source IP
recommended_actions: Check whether the source is a known corporate proxy, VPN, or identity provider. | Review targeted accounts for subsequent successful logins. | Apply approved rate limiting and MFA protections; avoid blocking shared infrastructure without validation.

title: Repeated authentication failures
why_it_fired: Observed 5 failed authentications for user 'soc_test_attacker_103423' from 127.0.0.1 within 5 minutes; threshold is 5.
rule_threshold: 5 failures / 5 minutes / same user + source IP
recommended_actions: Verify whether the source and target user are expected. | Check adjacent authentication events and endpoint telemetry. | If unauthorized, block or rate-limit the source through approved controls and reset affected credentials.
